blocks.content: • Policyholder – Person who owns an insurance policy.
Sum Assured – Guaranteed amount paid on claim.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The policyholder is the owner of the insurance policy.
A premium is the payment required to secure insurance coverage.
Sum Assured is the predefined guaranteed amount paid upon making a claim.
Reinsurance allows insurers themselves to buy insurance to minimize financial risk.

blocks.content: • Premium – Amount paid for insurance coverage.

items: Distinguish between Premium (cost paid for insurance) and Sum Assured (guaranteed amount received on claim).
Reinsurance is a frequent exam question: remember it is insurance taken by insurers, not individuals, to reduce risk.

blocks.content: • Sum Assured – Guaranteed amount paid on claim.
• Reinsurance – Insurance taken by insurers to reduce risk.
